2027-10-01.title: Don’t Forget Who Is In Charge
2027-10-01.verse: Jesus replied, “You would have no authority over me at all, unless it was given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of greater sin.
2027-10-01.observation: Recently I have been dealing with an issue. I was complaining to someone that I had to figure this out and I did not know what I was going to do. While hearing all this talk, it occurred to me there were way too many “I” statements floating around. At the end of the day, it is my responsibility to do my part, but I am not in control. Everything is in God’s hands. This means nothing happens outside His knowledge and His allowance. This can be difficult to understand when we grapple with the evil things in the world. Evil is not created by God. Evil is the twisting of something good. We don’t always understand why God does not stop some of the bad things that happen. However, we know He is good and would rather He be in control doing things we do not always understand, than having no one in control and swerving us into the ditch. So, we do the best we can and trust the Lord is moving us all the way that is best.
2027-10-01.application: Trust that while you are doing your best, the Lord is doing what you will never see. He is orchestrating things to work out the only way they could and it is ultimately for your good.
2027-10-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, that You are trustworthy when things do not make sense.

2027-10-02.title: He Will Show Himself
2027-10-02.verse: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here, and examine my hands. Extend your hand and put it into my side. Do not continue in your unbelief, but believe.
2027-10-02.observation: Thomas has the unfortunate nickname of “Doubting Thomas.” Thomas realized what Jesus coming back from the dead would mean. That would mean Jesus was and is God. He couldn’t believe that just because others said it was true. He needed to believe it for himself. In this way, Thomas is someone we should admire. We should never believe something because someone else said we should. We should believe it because we have examined the evidence ourselves. There is nothing wrong with examining the evidence for Christianity. Here is the great news. Jesus wants to reveal Himself to you. If you will examine the evidence for Christianity, you’ll end up like Thomas. You will fall to your knees and declare that Jesus is Lord of all.
2027-10-02.application: If you are dealing with doubts, don’t let them cause you to walk away from Christianity. Lean in and watch what God will do.
2027-10-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for revealing Yourself to us.

2027-10-03.title: The God Who Restores Us
2027-10-03.verse: Then when they had finished breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these do?” He replied, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you.” Jesus told him, “Feed my lambs.” Jesus said a second time, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” He replied, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd my sheep.” Jesus said a third time, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” Peter was distressed that Jesus asked him a third time, “Do you love me?” and said, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
2027-10-03.observation: Peter had denied Jesus three times on the night Jesus was arrested. Jesus asks Peter three times about Peter’s love for Him. Jesus gave Peter a chance to repent for his failure and invites Peter back. Jesus is not interested in throwing you away when you fail. He is interested in bringing you back. If you have walked away from God or are not honoring Him in an area of your life, bring it back to Him. Confess, and the Lord is waiting to forgive. He is the God who restores us.
2027-10-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always forgiving and restoring us.
